`claude-tokenizer.json` is the vocabulary of Anthropic's public Claude tokenizer,
copied unchanged from [`@anthropic-ai/tokenizer`](https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-tokenizer-typescript)
0.0.4 (`dist/cjs/claude.json`). Its license is in `LICENSE-anthropic-tokenizer`.
`lib/bpe.mjs` runs it in plain JavaScript, so the plugin needs no npm install.
